replies.author: Lieutenantpants
replies.body: Avicus' set of gametypes is what sets it apart from most other servers. Bringing Hunger/Survival Games to Avicus just doesn't fit the *Avicus vibe* if you will. As has been said, elimination is essentially Survival games. As you said yourself, very few people play it. Survival Games simply wouldn't be a good fit for Avicus.
